title: The Goodwill Allowance Written Off an Equipment Rental and Demo Settlement
content:
An agreement that has had the shop's attention during the hire — a guest who came back to the counter and had something raised on the agreement — carries a goodwill allowance against what the counter takes, and the longer the kit was out the larger that allowance is.

## The rule

Where the shop holds a request raised on the agreement, and the rental account carries at least 5 dates the kit was out, the service goodwill allowance is written off what is taken. The service goodwill allowance is 25.00 USD.

Where the shop holds a request raised on the agreement and the rental account carries fewer than 5 dates the kit was out, the small goodwill allowance is written off instead. The small goodwill allowance is 10.00 USD.

In any other case nothing is written off under this heading.

## The two conditions in combination

| A request stands raised on the agreement | Dates the account carries for the kit being out | Written off what is taken |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 5 or more | 25.00 USD |
| yes | 4 or fewer | 10.00 USD |
| no | any | nothing under this heading |

The day count of 5 is met by 5 dates and not by 4. Where no request stands raised on the agreement the dates are not weighed at all, however many the account carries.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical settlement

Take an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement whose counter figure stands at 320.25 USD.

- A request stands raised on the agreement and the account carries 6 dates the kit was out: 25.00 USD is written off.
- A request stands raised on the agreement and the account carries 2 dates the kit was out: 10.00 USD is written off.
- No request stands raised on the agreement, and the account carries 9 dates the kit was out: nothing is written off under this heading.

## Point of judgement

**Which requests count.** Any request standing raised on that agreement opens the allowance; what the request was for does not narrow it. One request is enough, and more than one does not widen it.
